Description: MSX cartridge slot, 50 pins (2 x 25), 2.54 mm pitch
Box header 50 pins (2 x 25), 2.54 mm, for the ribbon cable to the MSX
GAL22V10, programmed with gal/FPGA_EXP_ADR_BANKING.jed: subslot register FFFFh
GAL16V8, programmed with gal/FPGA_EXP_IO_CTRL.jed: subslot selects /EXP0-/EXP3
8-input NAND, together they detect address FFFFh (IC101 A0-A5, A13, A14; IC102 A6-A12, A15)
DC-DC converter 5 V to +12 V / -12 V (Murata NMA0512SC) for the slots
USB type B socket (FCI/Berg PN61729-S), 5 V power input
Ferrite bead in the 5 V input, axial, 10 mm pitch
Signal diode: /INT and /BUSDIR of the slots to the MSX
Resistor 10 kOhm, axial, 10 mm pitch: pull-ups /INT, /BUSDIR, /EXP0-/EXP3
Resistor 10 Ohm, axial, 10 mm pitch, in the sound input of each slot
Trimmer potentiometer 10 kOhm: sound level of each slot
LED 3 mm green with built-in resistor for 5 V (LED101 MSX powered, LED102 expander powered)
Electrolytic capacitor 470 uF 16 V, radial, 3.5 mm pitch, 8 mm diameter
Ribbon cable 50 wires with two IDC sockets 2 x 25, 2.54 mm (to the SVI-728 or to the Slot2Bus adapter)
